system.description: You may use Touch the Flame as a consistent action. For each AP you expend beyond the first, trigger the next level of Hemorrhage that target possesses (i.e., if you expend 2 AP against a target with 3 Hemorrhage, they take damage from 3 levels of Hemorrhage, then damage from 2 levels of Hemorrhage, and reduce their overall Hemorrhage count to 1 after triggering both levels).
